name: Newspaper — body test fixture
description: Test fixture for the newspaper Surface's Identity Spec dimensions 2 (halftone-at-body) and 3 (ink-bleed-at-edges). Title + body paragraph at body cap-height so the shader's mid-tone halftone has surface area to attack. Not a shippable Preset — this exists so the Critic can verify the newspaper-physics shader pass renders correctly under realistic content.

content.title: Bun Quietly Replaced npm
content.author: BY STAFF
content.body:
Over the past eighteen months, a [highlight]quiet displacement[/highlight] has taken place in the JavaScript package management ecosystem. Bun, once a curiosity, now ships in production at companies that until recently treated npm as immutable infrastructure.

The shift was not announced. There was no migration document, no postmortem. Engineers tried Bun on a side project, noticed the cold install was several times faster, and never went back. The cumulative effect, by early this year, is a meaningful divergence in default tooling between teams who hire from each other.
